Hepatic encephalopathy Hepatic encephalopathy (portal systemic encephalopathy) is a metabolically related dysfunction of the brain associ- ated with abnormalities of liver function. It may be acute, as in patients with fulminant hepatic failure, or chronic, with acute episodes precipitated by some triggering factor, as in patients with cirrhosis or other chronic liver disease. Treatment is aimed at identifying and correcting any pre- cipitating factor, decreasing the production and absorption of ammonia in the gut, and increasing metabolism of ammonia in the tissues.
